reviewMethod: Inspected the exact three-file diff and tested the matcher boundary cases added by the fix.
Ran targeted Go tests, race tests, shell syntax validation, shellcheck and static delivery wiring checks from the fix worktree.
Inspected the exact pinned Node 24.20.0/pnpm 11.24.0 site-build rerun and fixed image labels, platform and digest.
Ran the reviewed new smoke script against the cached pre-fix and fixed images with exact full revision labels.
Audited the fixed image HTML and verified both referenced hashed assets returned immutable cache headers.
limitations: Local image and local container smoke only; this review does not approve registry publication or production promotion.
Host architecture is arm64 while the candidate image is linux/amd64; the runtime emitted a platform warning.

verdict.summary: The cache-classification fix and strengthened all-asset smoke are independently supported for the exact local source and image scope. The pre-fix image fails and the fixed image passes the new checker; no P0-P2 finding remains.
